column3: With respect to the Tesla GR Mortgage Loan (1.5%), the borrower is permitted to rely on self-insurance, including self-insurance maintained by TESLA, Inc., the sole tenant at the Mortgaged Property, to satisfy the property insurance and the business income or rental loss insurance requirements in the Mortgage Loan documents, provided that certain conditions are satisfied, including that such insurance meets the insurance requirements under both the Mortgage Loan documents and the lease with TESLA, Inc.
